title: Sadie Litosky - HODGKIN LYMPHOMA
text: Sadie Litosky is a brave young girl from Canada. When Sadie was 19, she found out she was very sick with Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, a kind of cancer. At first, she had a small bump on her neck, but then she started having trouble breathing and felt pain in her chest. Sadie’s mom searched all over to find help. That’s when they found ITC. Sadie was not sure about it at first, but she liked how ITC’s plan was gentle and would not hurt her body too much. At ITC, Sadie got treatments that did not hurt a lot. After just two weeks, she felt better. Her chest did not hurt anymore, she could breathe easily, and she had more energy. After three and a half months, her cancer was gone! Sadie loved the kind nurses and doctors at ITC. Dr. Bautista talked to her honestly, and everyone made her feel safe. Sadie said, “I was welcomed by everyone here, which was really nice, especially when I was scared.” ITC helped Sadie go from feeling scared to feeling hopeful and happy again.

title: Karla Leonard - BREAST CANCER
text: Karla Leonard is a strong and brave woman from California. She had very bad breast cancer that spread to other parts of her body. Karla felt scared and sad, but she did nt give up hope. She went to ITC for help in May 2013. At first, Karla’s son was not sure about ITC, but Karla believed it could help her. When she got there, she saw how kind and caring everyone was. The treatments were gentle and did not hurt her body too much. Karla liked how the doctors always told her what was happening and how she was getting better. After three weeks of treatment at ITC in Mexico, Karla went back home. She kept doing what the doctors told her, like eating healthy food and taking her medicine. One day, Karla noticed the lumps on her breast were gone! She felt so happy and proud of herself. Now, Karla does not need her oxygen tank or wheel chair anymore. She can breathe and walk on her own. Karla knows there are still hard days, but she feels strong and free again. ITC helped Karla feel better and enjoy her life

title: Troy Clark - PROSTATE CANCER
text: Troy Clark is a strong and brave man. In 2018, he found out he had a sickness called Stage 3 Prostate Cancer. Troy remembered how his dad went through treatments that made him feel very tired and weak. Troy wanted to find a different way to get better. A friend told Troy about a special place called Immunity Therapy Center, or ITC. Troy decided to give it a try. When he got there, he felt happy because everyone was so kind and respectful. Troy said, “Everyone at ITC treats me with the utmost respect. What I get here from ITC, other people, and their experiences is just a great feeling overall.” After getting help from ITC, Troy got better. Now, he has been healthy and free from cancer for almost 5 years! Troy’s story shows how ITC helps people feel better and live happy lives.

title: Debbie Halper - LIVER CANCER
text: “The Immunity Therapy Center Saved My Life and I Hope they Can Help You Too” Debbie was very sick with a rare kind of cancer in her liver and near her stomach. The doctors told her it was very serious and hard to fix. Debbie felt very scared. One day, Debbie found ITC online and decided to give it a try. She started her treatment on May 1st. The nurses and doctors at ITC were so kind and worked hard to help her. Debbie felt safe and cared for. After just 6 weeks, Debbie’s liver cancer was all gone! Her doctor in California made a new plan to help her get rid of the other cancer. Now, Debbie is healthy and free from cancer. Debbie wants to tell everyone, “If you feel like there is no hope, there is hope!”
